text: Good evening, I am the grandad of a little girl Maisie who is 9 month old and I am on my own with her tonight and I have had a proper scare so please bare with me. She has been teething all day, dribbling everywhere, chewing on anything she can get her hands on, the remote, my fingers, the lot, and one of her cheeks is bright red. About 7 oclock she was sick once all down my jumper which set me off worrying but she has had her milk and some water since and kept all of it down no bother. Her nappys have been wet as normal, I have changed two since and both were proper wet so I dont think shes drying out. She is wide awake and full of beans, sat watching the telly with me babbling away, so she seems her usual self. Now the bit that frightend me, I looked down and round her mouth was all purple and I nearly rang an ambulance, but then I saw the empty beaker and it was the blackcurrant juice, I wiped it with a cloth and it came off and the cloth went purple too. Daft old fool. I just wanted to check that with the being sick and the teething there is nothing I should be doing or watching for. Thankyou very much
